name: Barba JS UI
description: Interface for configuring Barba.js loading with file, plugin, and access restrictions.
project_description: Barba JS UI is the configuration submodule of Barba JS. It adds an admin settings form at /admin/config/user-interface/barba/settings (permission 'administer barba') that replaces the base module's automatic library attachment with configurable rules: a global load on/off switch, Local vs CDN attach method, minified vs non-minified build variant, per-plugin checkboxes (core, CSS, prefetch, router), theme visibility (only-selected or all-except), and path-pattern visibility with wildcard support plus a ?barba=no per-request override. Settings are stored in the barbajs_ui.settings config object and enforced through hook_page_attachments in barbajs_ui.module.
